title: DatasetBronzeAvailableEvent
description: Integration event published by DatasetProcessingFunction after a successful Bronze write. Consumed by the downstream Silver-layer processing function. Published to the 'dataset-bronze-available' Service Bus queue.

record_count.description: Number of canonical records written to the Bronze Parquet partition.

bronze_path.description: Storage URI of the written Parquet partition. Format: {endpoint}/{filesystem}/{dataset_id}/{date}/data.parquet

schema_version.description: Schema version used during processing. Propagated from the triggering DatasetAvailableEvent.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event publication.
